tools.name: get_security_metrics
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how a single US stock or ETF has performed or how risky it is: YTD, 1-year and 5-year annualized returns, max drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, beta and alpha, with a 1Y/5Y chart. End-of-day data for US large and mid caps, major foreign stocks and US ETFs. Not for intraday quote

tools.name: compare_securities
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare 2 to 5 US stocks or ETFs side by side (e.g. "VOO vs QQQ", "SCHD or VYM?"): returns, drawdown, Sharpe, beta and how correlated they are, with an overlaid 1Y/5Y chart. End-of-day data for US large and mid caps, major foreign stocks and US ETFs. Not for intraday

tools.name: backtest_portfolio
tools.description: Use this when the user describes a portfolio of US stocks and ETFs with weights (e.g. "60% VTI, 40% BND", "equal parts AAPL, MSFT, NVDA") and wants to know how it would have done or how risky it is: returns over YTD, 1 year and 5 years (rebalanced quarterly), max drawdown, Sharpe, beta vs SPY and th

tools.name: screen_securities
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a ranked list of US stocks or ETFs by a performance or risk metric, optionally within a sector or ETF category (e.g. "lowest volatility dividend ETFs", "highest Sharpe tech stocks this year", "energy stocks with the smallest drawdown"). Covers about 2,500 US-listed stock

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "screen_securities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
